# KIMI Properties

> KIMI Properties is a trusted real estate agency based in Nagpur, Maharashtra, India. We specialize in buying, selling, and renting Industrial, Commercial, Residential, and Agricultural properties across Nagpur and surrounding areas.

## About

KIMI Properties is Nagpur's premier real estate consultancy, connecting buyers and sellers of properties across all categories. We offer end-to-end property services including site visits, documentation support, legal verification, and negotiation assistance. Our expertise covers MIDC industrial zones, commercial hubs, residential townships, agricultural farmland, and open plots.

## Services

- Industrial property sales and leasing (MIDC zones)
- Commercial space acquisition (offices, shops, godowns, warehouses)
- Residential flat buying and resale (1BHK, 2BHK, 3BHK apartments)
- Agricultural land deals with documentation support
- Plot sales and investment advisory
- Property valuation and market analysis
- Rental property management
- Legal documentation and title verification

## Property Types

- Industrial Land & Sheds (Butibori MIDC, Hingna MIDC)
- Commercial Offices & Shops
- Godowns & Warehouses
- Residential Flats & Apartments
- Agricultural Land & Farmland
- Open Plots & NA Plots
- Premium Commercial Plots

## Locations Served

Nagpur city and surrounding areas including:
- Butibori MIDC
- Hingna MIDC
- Wardha Road
- Manish Nagar
- Wadi
- Besa-Pipla
- Wanadongri
- Umred Road
- Sadar
- Dharampeth
- Sitabuldi
- Kamptee
- Koradi
- Parseoni

## Price Range

Properties listed from Rs 30 Lakh to Rs 5 Crore and above, covering budget-friendly to premium segments.
